feature_flags.default: all flags off; flag-off leaves existing runtime/UI/package behavior unchanged

attributes_added_via_registry_seed_note: Surface-level attribute identifiers are returned by the resolver; CSV/JSON registry seeding deferred to Stage C alongside UI palette additions.
nodes_added_note: Node-registry seed entries deferred to Stage C; the resolver functions today as a service-layer call from existing equity preview nodes.
insights_added_note: Insight extraction follows Stage C wiring; Stage A surfaces the underlying observations from which Stage C will construct insights.
api_endpoints_deferred: POST /viza/equity/text/sentiment/prepopulate (Stage D supplies prepopulate() function; the HTTP wrapper lands with the desktop UI in Stage C-desktop)
ui_components_added_or_modified_note: Desktop UI (Electron/React/Tailwind) deferred to Stage C-desktop; backend exposes the API surface the UI will consume.

cache_policy.cache_key_to_observation_cardinality: one cache_key maps to N chunk observations (one per chunk); chunk_id is unique within the cache_key bucket

pit_summary.available_at_basis: filing acceptanceDateTime (minute precision) or day-precision fallback at 21:00 ET

known_limitations: Real FinBERT inference requires `transformers` (and `torch`) to be installed; not installed in the verification environment. The transformers implementation imports lazily and raises FinbertDependencyMissing if absent.
ONNX/INT8 path is a deferred stub (raises OnnxDeferred). A follow-up commit (Stage B') must include accuracy-equivalence tests against the transformers baseline.
Section parser handles only iXBRL-tagged 10-K/10-Q and 8-K item lists. Pre-2009 filings without iXBRL tags emit `section_unparseable` with a warning.
MODEL_RELEASE_DATES table contains only ProsusAI/finbert v1.0; other model versions block live_historical_PIT mode with `model_release_date_unknown`.
Desktop UI surface (Electron panel) and the prepopulation HTTP endpoints are deferred to Stage C-desktop.
Live SEC filing fetch is deferred to Stage C-connector; Stage A-C accept `mock_parsed_sections` so the FastAPI surface is exercisable in tests today.
Not production-hardened. Outputs are research evidence, not investment advice.
next_backlog_items: Stage B': ONNX export + INT8 quantization + accuracy-equivalence tests

Stage C-connector: wire viza.equity.connectors.SecPublicClient into the resolver to replace mock_parsed_sections
